name: Yuusha ga Yadoya no Shujin kara Koibito o Netoru Hanashi.
original_name: 勇者が宿屋の主人から恋人を寝取る話。
source:
The timeline begins five years after hordes of monsters which are called orcs in past documents had appeared and had begun to constantly terrorize the people.
They are plundering, killing and kidnapping young women for their reproduction as there are solely male orcs.

The kingdom tried to root them out by mobilizing the army but failed because of the hit-and-run tactics of the monsters.
At last they formed a new counter-plan.
Small monster hunting bands were created from veterans and adventureres called MUT and imposed with the right to demand any cooperation from the people they are defending, including free housing and the right on any woman.

At the beginning of the story three people of MUT are coming to a certain rural town at the frontier of the kingdom to root out nearby monsters.
translation:
时间线开始于过去文献中被称为兽人的成群怪物出现并开始不断恐吓人民的五年后。
由于兽人中只有男性，他们为了生育而掠夺、杀害和绑架年轻女性。

王国试图动员军队铲除它们，但由于怪物的打了就跑的战术而失败。
最后他们制定了新的应对计划。
小型怪物狩猎乐队由退伍军人和冒险家组成，名为“MUT”，并被赋予要求他们所捍卫的人提供任何合作的权利，包括免费住房和任何女性的权利。

故事一开始，MUT的三人来到王国边境的某个乡村小镇，铲除附近的怪物。
